          (function () {
            // 19.0.1.128.0: another transfer slot, and the amount read from the
            // receipt (/cobro/leer, gives up after a few seconds)
            var form = document.getElementById('cobro-form');
            if (!form || !window.fetch || !window.FormData) { return; }
            var more = document.getElementById('cobro-otra');
            var slots = form.querySelectorAll('[data-tr]');
            function hidden() { return Array.prototype.filter.call(slots, function (s) { return s.hidden; }); }
            if (hidden().length) { more.hidden = false; }
            more.addEventListener('click', function () {
              var next = hidden()[0];
              if (next) { next.hidden = false; }
              if (!hidden().length) { more.hidden = true; }
            });
            // 19.0.1.129.1: large preview of the picked receipt (an object URL,
            // freed when the file is replaced); tap to see it full screen
            function el(tag, attrs, text) {
              var node = document.createElement(tag);
              Object.keys(attrs || {}).forEach(function (k) { node.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]); });
              if (text) { node.textContent = text; }
              return node;
            }
            function fullScreen(url) {
              var box = el('div', {id: 'cobro-full', role: 'dialog', 'aria-label': 'Comprobante'});
              var bar = el('div', {'class': 'bar'});
              var close = el('button', {type: 'button'}, 'Cerrar');
              var view = el('div', {'class': 'view'});
              view.appendChild(el('img', {src: url, alt: 'Comprobante'}));
              bar.appendChild(close);
              box.appendChild(bar);
              box.appendChild(view);
              function shut() { box.remove(); document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey); }
              function onKey(ev) { if (ev.key === 'Escape') { shut(); } }
              close.addEventListener('click', shut);
              view.addEventListener('click', shut);
              document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
              document.body.appendChild(box);
              close.focus();
            }
            function preview(slot, file) {
              var box = slot.querySelector('[data-preview]');
              if (!box) { return; }
              if (box.objectUrl) { URL.revokeObjectURL(box.objectUrl); box.objectUrl = null; }
              box.textContent = '';
              box.hidden = true;
              if (!file || !window.URL || !URL.createObjectURL) { return; }
              var url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
              box.objectUrl = url;
              var pdf = file.type === 'application/pdf' || /\.pdf$/i.test(file.name);
              if (pdf) {
                box.appendChild(el('iframe', {src: url, title: 'Comprobante (PDF)'}));
                var open = el('a', {href: url, target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener', 'class': 'btn outline'},
                              'Ver en pantalla completa');
                box.appendChild(open);
                box.appendChild(el('div', {'class': 'hint'},
                                   'Si el PDF no se ve aquí, toque «Ver en pantalla completa».'));
              } else {
                var img = el('img', {src: url, alt: 'Comprobante: toque para verlo en pantalla completa'});
                img.addEventListener('click', function () { fullScreen(url); });
                box.appendChild(img);
                box.appendChild(el('div', {'class': 'hint'}, 'Toque la foto para verla en pantalla completa.'));
              }
              box.hidden = false;
            }
            Array.prototype.forEach.call(form.querySelectorAll('[data-leer]'), function (input) {
              input.addEventListener('change', function () {
                var slot = input.closest('[data-tr]');
                var amount = slot.querySelector('input[name^=importe_transf_]');
                var hint = slot.querySelector('[data-hint]');
                preview(slot, input.files.length ? input.files[0] : null);
                if (!input.files.length) { return; }
                var body = new FormData();
                body.append('csrf_token', form.querySelector('[name=csrf_token]').value);
                body.append('archivo', input.files[0]);
                hint.textContent = 'Leyendo el comprobante…';
                fetch('/cobro/leer', {method: 'POST', body: body, credentials: 'same-origin'})
                  .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
                  .then(function (r) {
                    if (r.amount_text) {
                      if (!amount.value.trim()) { amount.value = r.amount_text; }
                      hint.textContent = r.amount_sure ? 'Importe leído: revisalo.' : 'Importe leído con dudas: revisalo mirando la foto.';
                    } else {
                      hint.textContent = r.notice || r.error || 'No se leyó el importe: escribilo.';
                    }
                  }, function () { hint.textContent = 'No se leyó el importe: escribilo.'; });
              });
            });
          })();
